help.header:
# PurgeBot

Powerful message management for Discord servers.

commands.title: ## Bot Commands
commands.body:
**`/purge user`** — Delete messages from a specific user
**`/purge role`** — Delete messages from role members
**`/purge everyone`** — Clear all messages (channel/category only)
**`/purge bot`** — Delete messages from bot accounts
**`/purge inactive`** — Remove messages from ex-members
**`/purge webhook`** — Delete messages sent by webhooks
**`/purge deleted`** — Clean up deleted account messages
**`/cancel`** — Cancel a running purge
**`/customize`** ✨ — Customize the bot's appearance for this server

parameters.title: ## Parameters
parameters.body:
**• target_id** — Where to purge (server/category/channel)
**• days** — Time limit (1–30 days)
**• include_threads** — Include messages from threads (default: false)
**• include_bots** — Include bot messages (`role`, `everyone`, `inactive` only, default: false)
**• user/role** — Target for specific commands

filtering.title: ## Filtering
filtering.body:
**• filter** — Text or regex pattern to match message text or attachments
**• filter_mode** — How to match (`contains`/`regex`/`exact`/`starts_with`/`ends_with`)
**• filter_keep** — Keep what the filter matches and delete everything else
**• case_sensitive** — Make filter case-sensitive (default: false)
**• skip_user** — Never delete this user's messages (`role`/`everyone`/`bot`/`inactive` only)
**• skip_messages** — Message links or IDs to never delete, separated by commas or spaces

-# The filter also matches attachment filenames and types, so `filter:\.mp4$` with `regex` reaches uploads.
-# Without filter_mode the filter is a plain substring match, not a pattern.

permissions.title: ## Required Permissions
permissions.body:
**Manage Messages** — To delete messages in channels
**View Channel** — To access channels for purging
**Read Message History** — To fetch existing messages

-# Users need **Manage Messages** permission to use purge commands.
